name: LunchBots Medium Trio
description: LunchBots Medium Trio, a three-section 18/8 stainless steel container. The listing says stainless steel is what touches the food and that the lids and dividers are not watertight.
features: The Amazon listing for ASIN B01IC243S2 says the container is 18/8 stainless steel and that, even with the colorful dot covers, 18/8 stainless steel is all that touches the food.
The same listing says the lids and dividers are not watertight and to pack dry foods.
The brand homepage says the inside of every LunchBots bento is stainless steel or platinum silicone so that no plastic comes into contact with the food. That page does not use the word PFAS.
This directory has not tested the steel or the lid.
labelNote: The listing's food-contact claim is 18/8 stainless steel. It does not say the box is leakproof, and it does not say PFAS-free.
